description: Publisher-edition original-question regressions. Source version independently inspected before model execution using official ACL PDF SHA and native text. Original uploaded-paper references are preserved separately. PDF page indices 1-2 correspond to printed proceedings pages 42-43. AI-curated references, zero human reviews.

cases.question: According to the 3LM paper, what problem does the work address, and what are its main contributions? Cite supporting passages and page numbers.
expected_points: A gap in Arabic LLM evaluation for STEM and code.
Three comprehensive STEM/code benchmarks: authentic native Arabic content curation, synthetic generation, and careful translation with human verification.
Extensive evaluation of over 40 state-of-the-art Arabic and multilingual LLMs in scientific and programming domains.
Cross-task correlations and robustness testing, with insights into model behavior and relationships between cognitive capabilities.

references.text:
Most existing
Arabic benchmarks focus on linguistic, cultural,
or religious content, leaving a signiﬁcant gap
in domains like STEM and code which are in-
creasingly relevant for real-world LLM applica-
tions.

The contributions of this paper are threefold:
First, we present three comprehensive benchmarks
spanning STEM domains and code generation, con-
structed through rigorous methodologies that en-
sure authenticity and quality from native Arabic
content curation to synthetic generation and careful

translation with human veriﬁcation. Second, we
conduct an extensive evaluation of over 40 state-of-
the-art Arabic and multilingual LLMs, providing
the most comprehensive assessment of Arabic lan-
guage model capabilities in scientiﬁc and program-
ming domains to date. Third, we perform thorough
analysis including cross-task correlations and ro-
bustness testing, revealing insights into model be-
havior and the relationship between diﬀerent cog-
nitive capabilities in Arabic LLMs.
